_comment: Published speculative-decoding measurements, one entry per model.
These are the model authors' or the serving stack's own numbers, not this
repo's estimates, and each carries its source so it can be checked. The
simulator reads a model's entry as the default when speculative decoding is
enabled; --num-speculative-tokens and --spec-acceptance-rate override it.
A model absent from this file has no published figure we could find, and
must be given --spec-acceptance-rate explicitly.
acceptance_rate is accepted/drafted -- what every one of these sources
reports -- and it is a MARGINAL rate: the fraction of draft steps in which a
given position was accepted, already including the probability of reaching
it. So the mean accepted length is
mean_accept_length = 1 + sum(per-position marginals)
= 1 + acceptance_rate * num_speculative_tokens
which reproduces all nine published (rate, length) pairs collected here to
within 0.01 tokens.
This is NOT Leviathan's per-position alpha (ICML 2023, arXiv:2211.17192),
which is CONDITIONAL -- position i is reached only if 1..i-1 were accepted --
and yields the capped-geometric (1 - a^(N+1))/(1 - a). Feeding one of these
rates into that formula under-predicts the published accept length by 25-30%
(MiniMax-M3 2.42 against a published 3.0; Qwen 3.51 against 4.89). The
check that settles the reading: Qwen's published per-position decline of
95% at p1 to 60% at p5 gives 0.775 read as marginals against a published
0.779, and 0.621 read as conditionals.
position_acceptance is those marginals per draft position, used by the DECAY
policy. Only Qwen publishes them; the endpoints are the source's, the
interior is a linear ramp between them, and its mean reproduces the source's
own aggregate.

deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V3.2-Exp.source: GLM-5 technical report (arXiv:2602.15763) Table 2, 'Comparison of accept lengths of DeepSeek-V3.2 and GLM-5', at 4 speculative steps. DeepSeek-V3.2's own report (arXiv:2512.02556) does not discuss speculative decoding; DeepSeek-V3's (arXiv:2412.19437 sec 5.4.3) reports 85-90% for the second token, i.e. the first draft position only.

zai-org/GLM-5.source: GLM-5 technical report (arXiv:2602.15763) Table 2, at 4 speculative steps on the authors' prompt set. GLM-5 shares 3 MTP layers during training to close the training-inference gap DeepSeek-V3's single MTP layer leaves.

MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3.source: vLLM day-0 serving guide for MiniMax-M3 (vllm.ai/blog/2026-06-12-minimax-m3-vllm): 'Speculative acceptance on Sonnet ~67%, mean accept length ~3.0', draft model Inferact/MiniMax-M3-EAGLE3, num_speculative_tokens 3, on B300.

Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B.source: vLLM 'Exploring Speculative Decoding in vLLM on AMD GPUs' (vllm.ai/blog/2026-08-23-speculative-decoding-amd-gpus), native MTP on Qwen3.5-27B, GSM8K, N=5: 4.89 mean accept length, 77.9% acceptance, 1.63x. Same family and size as Qwen3.8-27B, which publishes no figure of its own. position_acceptance takes the source's reported decline from 95% at p1 to 60% at p5 and ramps linearly between; read as marginals its mean is 0.775 against the source's own 0.779.
